metadata.title: Too Little Grease Brought Down Alaska 261
metadata.description:
Alaska 261 dove into the Pacific Ocean. The cause: stripped acme nut threads on the horizontal stabilizer trim jackscrew.

Failure chain: Lubrication intervals extended → Grease missed → Nut threads wear away → Stabilizer jams, then slips → Uncontrollable dive

Related episode: Pilots Fixing a Navigation Fault Didn't Notice the Dive — https://youtu.be/3LP2gm1cx4k

Series — Aviation Failures: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLHIwDgtDRNyY
